Rima Shah: Heads-up: nightly SAST flagged a hardcoded secret in `gen/oauth/callback.go` coming from generated artifacts. Looks like CI injected a deploy token during codegen.
Omar Castillo: paste snippet?
Rima Shah: `var signingKey = "TEMP_SIGNING_KEY_ABC123"` in `gen/oauth/callback.go`. Local repo has placeholder `REDACTED`.
scanbot: run#44891 1: SAST high hardcoded-secret fingerprint=sha256:aa11 collector=gha-staging.
Benji: likely flow: CI checks out private submodule with deploy-bot token, runs generator, token ends up baked into files.
Rima Shah: policy: we can either reorder CI so scan runs before private fetch, or submit a suppression with evidence + audit. Security opinion?
sec-bot: policy reminder: suppression requires PR with raw scanner output, repro, fingerprint, security + owner approval, and auditable KMS/Vault decrypt logs for that run. Suppressions >72h escalate.
Omar Castillo: infra: can we add `ci.run_id` and `repo` attrs to KMS decrypt calls so audit is searchable?
ci-bot: yes. I'll file infra/PR#112 to attach `ci.run_id` and add a least-privilege `ci:artifact-fetcher` role that has S3:GetObject but no KMS:Decrypt.
Benji: short-term plan proposed: (1) open suppression PR scoped to `gen/**` with 7-day expiry and evidence, (2) patch infra to add KMS metadata and create fetcher role, (3) generator ticket to stop emitting env literals.
Rima Shah: I'll draft suppression PR now referencing fingerprint `sha256:aa11` and include `repro.sh`.
Omar Castillo: add a canary: run reordered CI (scan-before-fetch) in parallel for 48h and compare results.
sec-bot: suppression template: `/suppress rule=hardcoded-secret scope=gen/** fingerprint=sha256:aa11 expires=2025-06-02 reason="CI-injected; generated artifact" evidence=https://ci.example/builds/44891/raw.json`
Benji: action items noted: infra/PR#112 (KMS metadata + role), repo/PR#89 (suppression draft), gen/issue#214.
Rima Shah: tagging @security for review. Will update incident-note in PR per workflow.
Omar Castillo: once suppression merges, security will run: `SELECT * FROM kms_audit WHERE attrs.ci_run_id='1750001234'` to validate decrypt event.
Rima Shah: thanks, closing loop tomorrow after audit check. :lock:
